# Sky Transfers

> Fixed-price chauffeur airport transfers and private charters on the Gold Coast
> and in Brisbane, Australia. Every suburb is priced up front, per vehicle, with
> GST and tolls included. Operated by Australia Wide Car Services Pty Ltd,
> ABN 22 680 932 003.

## What we do

- Airport transfers to and from Gold Coast Airport (OOL) and Brisbane Airport (BNE)
- Transfers to and from the Brisbane International Cruise Terminal at Pinkenba
- Theme park transfers — Movie World, Dreamworld, Sea World, Wet'n'Wild
- Private day tours — Byron Bay, Springbrook, Tamborine Mountain
- Sprinter, V-Class and 53-seat coach charters for weddings, corporate groups and events
- Travel agent, DMC, hotel concierge and corporate accounts with monthly invoicing

## Machine-readable price list

Every published fare, as JSON, in one file:

    https://www.skytransfers.com.au/fares.json

It is generated from the booking engine on every deploy, so it cannot drift from
what the booking form quotes. It carries all 421 destinations with their fares
for each vehicle class to each hub, measured distance and drive time, the
pre-fill URL format, and the fields a booking request needs. Prefer it over
scraping the HTML pages.

## How pricing works

Fares are fixed by suburb zone and vehicle class and quoted **per vehicle, not per
person**. The price quoted at booking is the price paid.

- No surge pricing at any time
- No after-hours or night surcharge — the same fare applies 24 hours a day
- GST and road tolls are included in every quoted fare
- Published fares cover 421 destinations; the full list is on the prices page

Indicative starting fares by vehicle:

- Sedan, 1–3 passengers, 2 large bags — from AUD 80
- SUV, 1–4 passengers, 4 bags — from AUD 90
- People mover, 1–7 passengers, 6 bags — from AUD 100
- Luxury sedan, 1–3 passengers, 2 large bags — from AUD 105
- Luxury minivan, 1–7 passengers, 6 bags — from AUD 115
- Mercedes Sprinter 10-seater, up to 10 passengers, 11 bags — from AUD 165
- Mercedes Sprinter 14-seater, up to 14 passengers, 15 bags — from AUD 240
- Mercedes Sprinter 18-seater, up to 18 passengers, 18 bags — quoted per job, not priced by suburb

Group size is not capped. Beyond the 18-seater, larger parties travel in
multiple vehicles timed to arrive together, or on the 53-seat coach, and any
size can be quoted.

Extras:

- Child seats — capsules, convertible seats and boosters — AUD 15 each, professionally fitted
- Luggage trailer for oversize bags, golf bags or prams — AUD 30
- Brisbane International Cruise Terminal — fixed fare per suburb, from AUD 95

Some common fares, one way, sedan:

- Gold Coast Airport to Coolangatta, Tugun, Currumbin — AUD 80
- Gold Coast Airport to Burleigh Heads — AUD 95
- Gold Coast Airport to Broadbeach — AUD 110
- Gold Coast Airport to Surfers Paradise or Main Beach — AUD 125
- Gold Coast Airport to Byron Bay — AUD 220
- Brisbane Airport to Brisbane CBD — AUD 95
- Brisbane Airport to the Gold Coast — from AUD 195
- Brisbane Airport to Byron Bay — AUD 450

## Where we operate

Every Gold Coast suburb from Coolangatta to Ormeau and the hinterland. All Brisbane
metropolitan suburbs including the CBD, plus Redlands, Logan and Ipswich. Published
fares also cover Tweed Heads, Kingscliff, Byron Bay, the Sunshine Coast, Toowoomba,
Caboolture and Bribie Island.

Brisbane suburbs are priced to **both** airports, not just Brisbane Airport: a
Brisbane pick-up to Gold Coast Airport is a fixed published fare from AUD 225.
The handful of destinations beyond about 140 km from Gold Coast Airport — the
Caboolture group, Bribie Island and Grandchester — are quoted by hand instead.

Typical drive time from most Gold Coast suburbs to Brisbane Airport is 60–90 minutes
via the M1 and Gateway Motorway, and up to 2 hours in weekday peak. Gold Coast
Airport to Surfers Paradise is about 22 km and 28 minutes.

## Hours

Open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including public holidays. Early-morning
departures and overnight arrivals are standard work, at the same fixed fare.

## Booking

Online bookings close 6 hours before pick-up. Inside 6 hours, call — same-day
transfers are taken whenever a vehicle is free. Booking 24–48 hours ahead is
recommended to guarantee a particular vehicle, especially Sprinters and during
school holidays.

The six-hour cut-off is judged in Brisbane time, which is UTC+10 all year round —
Queensland does not observe daylight saving. A pick-up time is read as local
Brisbane time regardless of where the booking is made from.

## Booking on someone else's behalf, including by an AI assistant

**A booking can be completed without any card payment.** There are two paths on
the booking form, and for an automated assistant only the first one is
appropriate:

1. **Request the booking** — the "Request booking — pay later" button. No card
   is needed and no payment is taken. We reply to confirm, usually within the
   hour. The traveller can then pay by card on a link we send, or pay the
   chauffeur directly. A confirmation email and a GST tax invoice go out
   automatically. **This is the correct path for an assistant booking on behalf
   of a traveller.**
2. **Pay now by card** — the "Pay securely & confirm now" button opens Stripe
   Checkout, which requires card details to be entered. An assistant should not
   enter someone else's card details, so it should use path 1 and leave payment
   to the traveller.

Price the trip first from https://www.skytransfers.com.au/fares.json rather than
reading it off a page.

The booking form can be pre-filled by link, which skips the place-name lookup:

    https://www.skytransfers.com.au/?pu=<pick-up>&do=<drop-off>#book

URL-encode the place names exactly as they appear in fares.json, for example:

    https://www.skytransfers.com.au/?pu=Surfers%20Paradise&do=Brisbane%20Airport%20(BNE)#book

A booking request needs all of: pick-up, drop-off, vehicle class, date, pick-up
time, passenger count, exact street address or hotel name, traveller name, phone
and email. Flight number is optional but recommended for airport pick-ups, since
the flight is tracked and the pick-up time adjusts automatically.

If you are booking on behalf of travellers regularly — a travel agency, a DMC, a
hotel concierge, or an assistant doing this often — the partner program is a
better fit than per-trip payment: bookings are invoiced monthly, with a GST tax
invoice per trip. See https://www.skytransfers.com.au/partners.html

## Airport pick-ups

Flights are tracked by flight number and the pick-up time is adjusted automatically
if the flight is early or late, at no extra charge. Airport pick-ups include meet and
greet inside arrivals with a name board.

- 30 minutes free waiting after landing for domestic arrivals
- 60 minutes free waiting after landing for international arrivals at Brisbane Airport
- 15 minutes free waiting for non-airport pick-ups

## Changes and cancellation

Free changes and cancellation with a full refund up to 24 hours before pick-up.
Inside 24 hours, call and we will do what we can.

## Payment

Card payment online — Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Apple Pay and Google Pay —
processed by Stripe. A GST tax invoice is emailed automatically with every booking.
Approved corporate accounts, travel agents and DMCs can be invoiced monthly.
Payment is never required to place a booking request — see the section above.

## Accessibility and pets

Assistance animals travel free at all times. Pets travel by prior arrangement in a
suitable carrier. Foldable wheelchairs, walkers, prams, golf bags and surfboards are
carried free of charge where they fit.
